# m.futures.snapshots

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Snapshots of futures contracts: the latest trade, quote, minute bar, and session.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.futures.snapshots(symbols, *, product_code=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`
- `poll(interval, mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND)`: appends each new state of a row, identified by `Symbol`, `LastQuoteLastUpdated` and `LastTradeLastUpdated`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Contract tickers, a contracts table, or `dm.ALL`. |
| `product_code` | Only contracts of this product (`"ES"`) or these (`["ES", "NQ"]`); None for every product. A table of codes, in a `ProductCode` column, reads each code as if passed alone; a live one is followed by `fetch()` and re-read by each `poll()` cycle. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Such as `"ticker"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | Needs `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Such as `{"ticker_gte": "ES"}`. Keys: `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Futures Contracts Snapshot (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Futures Basic | Not included |
| Futures Starter | 10-minute delayed |
| Futures Developer | 10-minute delayed |
| Futures Advanced | Real-time |
| Futures Business CME | Real-time |
| Futures Business CBOT | Real-time |
| Futures Business NYMEX | Real-time |
| Futures Business COMEX | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `details.ticker`. |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `DetailsProductCode` | String | The identifier for the contract's product. |
| `DetailsSettlementDate` | String | The day that this contract is settled. |
| `LastMinuteOpen` | double | The opening price at the start of the minute bar. |
| `LastMinuteHigh` | double | The highest price reached in the minute bar. |
| `LastMinuteLow` | double | The lowest price reached in the minute bar. |
| `LastMinuteClose` | double | The price at the end of the minute bar. |
| `LastMinuteVolume` | long | The number of contracts traded in the minute bar. |
| `LastMinuteLastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp indicating the most recent update to the minute bar. |
| `LastMinuteTimeframe` | String | The timeliness of the data as determined by your subscription. One of REAL-TIME or DELAYED. |
| `LastQuoteBid` | double | The highest price a buyer is willing to pay. |
| `LastQuoteBidSize` | long | The number of contracts available at the bid price. |
| `LastQuoteAsk` | double | The lowest price a seller is willing to accept. |
| `LastQuoteAskSize` | long | The number of contracts available at the ask price. |
| `LastQuoteBidTimestamp` | Instant | The time when the best bid price was last updated. |
| `LastQuoteAskTimestamp` | Instant | The time when the best ask price was last updated. |
| `LastQuoteLastUpdated` | Instant | The time when the quote was generated at the exchange to nanosecond precision. |
| `LastQuoteTimeframe` | String | The timeliness of the data as determined by your subscription. One of REAL-TIME or DELAYED. |
| `LastTradePrice` | double | The trade price is quoted per unit of the underlying asset, with the total contract value determined by multiplying by the contract’s specific multiplier. |
| `LastTradeSize` | long | The total number of contracts exchanged between buyers and sellers on a given trade. |
| `LastTradeLastUpdated` | Instant | The time when the trade was generated at the exchange to nanosecond precision. |
| `LastTradeTimeframe` | String | The timeliness of the data as determined by your subscription. One of REAL-TIME or DELAYED. |
| `SessionOpen` | double | The opening price at the start of the session. |
| `SessionHigh` | double | The highest price reached in the session. |
| `SessionLow` | double | The lowest price reached in the session. |
| `SessionClose` | double | The price at the end of the session. |
| `SessionVolume` | long | The number of contracts traded in the session. |
| `SessionChange` | double | The change in price during this session. |
| `SessionChangePercent` | double | The percentage change in price during this session. |
| `SessionPreviousSettlement` | double | The settlement price of the previous session. |
| `SessionSettlementPrice` | double | The final settlement price at the end of the session. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
